name: Teleport_Foe
display_help: You can Teleport nearly instantly to a single foe and launch a surprise attack on them for minor Smashing damage. Blink is so quick that your enemies will find you harder to hit, thus boosting your defense to most attacks briefly.  Damage: Minor, Recharge: Moderate
display_short_help: Ranged, Minor DMG(Smash), Self Teleport, +DEF(All but Psionics)
